title: 6 schema tests cannot be pinned down
why: An enum column whose allowed values come from a lifecycle that has not been drawn. Draw it at stage 4 and the check constraint — and this test — write themselves.

title: 43 unit tests cannot be pinned down
why: Either the class has no behaviour to test, or the states an operation is illegal in come from a lifecycle that has not been drawn.

title: 19 steps have no screen
why: "AI reads the items", "Quotation drafted", "Issue the PO", "PO received", "Consignment refilled" and others. Some of these are things the system does alone and need nothing; the rest are screens nobody has designed yet.

title: 9 of 19 choices answer no demand the design makes yet
why: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui, NestJS, Prisma, Claude vision (claude-opus-5-5), zxing-wasm (multi-barcode, on device), ZXing (GS1 DataMatrix / Code128), AWS ECS Fargate (ap-southeast-7), GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry + Grafana Cloud + Sentry. Perfectly reasonable things to want, but nothing in stages 1 to 8 asked for them — which is worth saying out loud before they become load-bearing.

title: No component tree yet
why: The screens name the controls; this is what renders them. Without it the front end has an inventory and no structure, and every state question gets answered per screen instead of once.

title: 4 of 10 accessibility checks are open
why: Still to confirm: everything works with a keyboard alone; tap targets are at least 24 × 24 px; colour is never the only signal (add an icon or text); and others.

title: Declared a modular monolith, but stage 5 gives it 2 separate data stores
why: Core DB (ConsignCare API, Job Worker); File Store (ConsignCare API, Job Worker, Document Renderer). One deployable usually means one database; stores owned by different services are the shape of separate deployables. Either merge them or change the declared style.
